newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan prices unlikely to rise rapidly - BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Japan prices unlikely to rise rapidly - BOJ.

text.p: Domestic prices in Japan are unlikely to rise rapidly, a senior Bank of Japan (BOJ) official told reporters on Tuesday.
The BOJ earlier announced that domestic prices in March, as measured by the wholesale price index, were unchanged from a year earlier after a sustained period of year-on-year drops.
"We don't think that domestic prices are going to rise rapidly," the official said.
"Year-on-year falls in domestic prices have been narrowing in line with a gradual recovery of the economy," he said.
"This trend will continue but the pace at which the year-on-year falls are narrowing is not accelerating unexpectedly," he said.
